title: Crown Him with Many Crowns
lyrics: A[D]wake my soul and [G]sing, of [E]Him who died for [A]Thee,[A7]
His [D]glories now we [G]sing, who [E]died and rose on [A]high,[A7]
Who [D/F#]died e[G]ternal [Em7]life to [D]bring and [Em7]lives that [A]death may [D]die.
[D]Crown Him the [Bm]Lord of [G]love, be[D/F#]hold His [G]hands and [Asus]side;[A]
All [D]hail Redeemer [G]hail, for [E]Thou hast died for [A]me,[A7]
artist: Elvey, George Job (1816-1893), Bridges, Matthew (1800-1894), Thring, Godfrey (1823-1903)
